# @circle-fin/unified-balance-kit

## 1.0.1

### Patch Changes

- Improved README documentation with corrected code examples and updated architecture diagrams

## 1.0.0

### Major Changes

- New SDK for managing a unified, cross-chain USDC balance. Deposit USDC on any supported chain, spend it instantly on any other chain, query balances across all chains, and manage delegate access — all without manual bridging or liquidity management
